# Reference-generated test data

`reedsolomon-v1.14.2.json` is generated by the project's original Go helper against the pinned MIT-licensed `github.com/klauspost/reedsolomon@v1.14.2`. Source bytes come from a deterministic unsigned 32-bit LCG in that helper, not an upstream corpus. It records the configured matrix, dimensions, inputs, erasures, requests, changed data and observed reference outputs. See [reproduction and scope](../docs/REFERENCE_COMPARISON.md) and [source notices](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

`reference_vectors_generated_test.mbt` is mechanically generated from this fixture with `tools/generate_reference_tests.py`; exclude it from handwritten implementation and source-scale measurements. Ordinary MoonBit tests require neither Go nor network access. The reference CI workflow preserves the independently generated fixture as an artifact, while the main CI job checks deterministic regeneration for drift.
